summary: Retested AuthDialog defaultTab sync bug from iteration_3. All scenarios pass: (1) Cold load → click Sign Up opens on Signup tab (data-state=active, signup-name visible). (2) Close, click Sign In opens on Login tab (login-flat visible, login tab active). (3) Close, click Sign Up again — dialog switches back to Signup tab (active) instead of being stuck on Login. (4) Signup regression: full signup with flat 405, plate KA05XY1234, password test1234 succeeded and user-chip shows '405'. Bug is FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthDialog.jsx useEffect syncing tab with defaultTab on open is correctly gated by `open` so it does not clobber user-driven tab switches while the dialog is open. Clean fix.
seed_data_creation: Created live user via signup: flat 405, vehicle KA05XY1234, password test1234, phone +91 98765 40505, name 'Test User 405'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthDialog tab switching between header 'Sign in' and 'Sign up' triggers is verified working via useEffect(open, defaultTab) sync. Fresh user for flat 405 exists in DB after this run.
rca of the issue: Original: internal `tab` state was initialized from defaultTab only on mount; since AuthDialog stays mounted (open toggled), subsequent changes of defaultTab prop had no effect. Fix: useEffect(() => { if (open) setTab(defaultTab); }, [defaultTab, open]) resyncs tab to the incoming defaultTab each time the dialog is opened, while leaving user-driven tab switches intact when the dialog is already open.
